settings.description: Velg mottakere og kilder. Bruk default for standardlyd; importer egne lydfiler i iPhone-appen først. Kritiske alarmvarsler krever egen tillatelse på iPhone.

data_description.door_open: Bruk nøyaktig rå tilstand fra Utviklerverktøy → Tilstander mens døren er åpen. Ikke det oversatte navnet på kortet.
data_description.door_closed: Bruk nøyaktig rå tilstand mens døren er lukket. Se også Sikkerhetsstatus for aktuell og forventet verdi.
data_description.delay_helper: Hvis valgt, bestemmer denne helperen ventetiden i sekunder og overstyrer ventetidsfeltet.
data_description.autolock_delay: 5–3600 sekunder fra åpen → lukket. Funksjonsbryteren Autolås må være på. En ny verdi her erstatter tidligere lagret ventetid.
data_description.blink_light: Tidligere lysstyrke, farge og av/på-tilstand gjenopprettes etter blinkingen.
data_description.unlock_window: Blinker én gang per opplåsing, når døren deretter åpnes innen denne tiden. Funksjonsbryteren må være på.
data_description.image_mode: Direct: the app fetches the image with its own login, nothing is stored. Saved: a still from the moment goes to www/ki_varslinger and requires the folder in allowlist_external_dirs.
data_description.image_delay: So whoever arrived is in the picture, not just an empty hallway.
data_description.group_seconds: Unlocked and opened shortly after each other becomes one updating notification. 0 sends one per event.
data_description.door_entity: Optional. Without a door sensor only locked and unlocked are notified.
data_description.live_activity: One notification that stays on the Lock Screen and updates, instead of new banners. Requires iOS 17.2 or Android 16 and Home Assistant 2026.7; older phones get an ordinary notification that is replaced. Alarm needs an alarm_control_panel entity, and autolock only shows a countdown when the delay is at least 60 seconds.
data_description.progress_entity: A number, e.g. battery percentage or cleaned share. Shown as a progress bar.
data_description.limit_entity: The bar is full when the battery reaches this value. Without it, 100 % counts as full.
data_description.remaining_entity: Minutes left (or another time unit), clock format such as 1:05:30, or a timestamp for when it finishes. The phone counts down by itself, so no update is sent every minute.
data_description.phase_entity: The text is shown as the message, e.g. "Rinsing". On iPhone the message is hidden while a countdown is shown.
data_description.active_states: Raw states from Developer tools → States, comma separated. The activity starts when the entity has one of them and ends when it no longer does.
data_description.open_delay: A door that is opened and closed again does not start an activity. iOS has a small budget for how often an activity can be started.
data_description.duration: Used when there is no sensor for remaining time: the countdown is measured from when the pump started.
data_description.live_url: A page in Home Assistant, e.g. /lovelace/laundry, or a full https address. Without it the default view opens.
data_description.live_priority: 0–1. The highest gets the Dynamic Island and the top of the Lock Screen. Use a low number for something that should just sit there, e.g. an open gate.
data_description.live_interval: iOS throttles and drops updates that arrive too often. Within this time only the latest is sent.
data_description.live_linger: How long the final message stays before the activity is removed. 0 removes it at once.
data_description.message: For custom progress: the words state, phase and progress in curly braces are replaced with the values.

error.missing_service: En valgt notify-handling finnes ikke. Velg navnet uten notify. foran.
error.duplicate_target: Samme telefon kan ikke være både iPhone og Android.
error.duplicate_source: Velg ulike brytere for de tre personene.
error.missing_person: Velg en person/telefon når du bruker sonefilter.
error.missing_ruter: Velg minst én telefon/person, skolesone og trikkesensor.
error.invalid_door_states: Åpen og lukket må ha ulike gyldige sensorverdier.
error.invalid_homey_options: Heimdall-alternativene må være ulike og finnes i select-entiteten.
error.invalid_webhooks: Velg tre ulike webhook-ID-er på minst 16 tegn, uten /, ? eller #.
error.webhook_in_use: En webhook-ID er allerede i bruk. Deaktiver gammel automasjon eller velg en ny ID.
error.missing_camera: Choose the camera at the door.
error.missing_entities: Choose at least one door, gate or window.
error.invalid_color: The colour must be a hex code such as #2196F3.
error.invalid_url: The address must start with / or https://.
